title: CHEEMS: A Practical Guidance for Building and Evaluating Chinese Reward Models
authors_zh: Xueru Wen, Jie Lou, Zichao Li, Yaojie Lu, Xing Yu, Yuqiu Ji, Guohai Xu, Hongyu Lin, Ben He, Xianpei Han, Le Sun, Debing Zhang
paper_type_zh: 中文奖励模型数据集与评测论文
best_for_zh: 需要构建、评测或审计中文奖励模型的研究者。
one_line: A released Chinese reward-model benchmark and preference dataset designed to expose gaps in reward-model training and evaluation.
CHEEMS 构建人工监督的中文奖励模型基准与偏好数据，揭示并改善中文偏好建模缺口。
why: It provides an auditable public surface for measuring or mitigating reward and judge reliability failures.
inclusion_reason: It exposes a concrete reward-model and evaluation-reliability surface with a public official artifact.

title: Problem
问题
html: Chinese reward-model work lacks large, reliable preference data and a Chinese evaluation surface; English-centric synthetic resources may not represent real Chinese preferences. CHEEMS constructs a human-centered benchmark and preference dataset, then uses them to measure this reliability gap and train a Chinese reward model.
中文奖励模型缺少大规模、可靠的偏好数据和中文评测面；以英语为中心的合成资源未必能代表真实中文偏好。CHEEMS 构建以人工监督为中心的基准与偏好数据集，并用它们量化可靠性缺口、训练中文奖励模型。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: CHEEMS combines CheemsBench, a fully human-annotated Chinese RM benchmark, with CheemsPreference, a human-machine preference dataset for RM training. CheemsBench has 2,492 prompts and 17,600 comparisons; CheemsPreference has 27,861 human instructions and 37,618 comparisons. The official repository releases code and data for evaluation and reward-model training.
CHEEMS 将完全人工标注的中文奖励模型基准 CheemsBench 与用于训练的人工—机器偏好数据集 CheemsPreference 结合。CheemsBench 有2,492个提示和17,600个比较；CheemsPreference 有27,861条人工指令和37,618个比较。官方仓库公开用于评测和奖励模型训练的代码与数据。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. CheemsBench samples 1,146 open prompts and 1,346 human instructions, generates five responses per prompt, collects five rounds of triple-wise human comparisons, resolves graph cycles, and outputs partial rankings.
  1. CheemsPreference collects 27,861 human instructions, samples more than five responses, and combines a small human-labeled subset with GPT-4o comparisons. A human-trained RM filters inconsistent GPT edges; length balancing reduces length bias.
  1. CheemsRM trains a Qwen2.5 reward model with Bradley-Terry pairwise loss over partial rankings plus score regularization. The released repository is required to verify data format, license, and training configuration.

1. CheemsBench 从1,146个开源提示和1,346条人工指令取样，每题生成5个回答，进行5轮三元人工比较，以图消环后输出部分排序。
  1. CheemsPreference 收集27,861条人工指令，每题采样超过5个回答，并结合小规模人工标注与 GPT-4o 比较。人工训练的奖励模型过滤不一致的 GPT 边，长度平衡减弱长度偏差。
  1. CheemsRM 在部分排序上以 Bradley-Terry 成对损失和分数正则训练 Qwen2.5 奖励模型。复现需核验公开仓库中的数据格式、许可与训练配置。

title: Evidence
证据
html: On CheemsBench, CheemsRM has overall score 0.657, versus 0.535 for the strongest listed discriminative baseline, Skywork-Reward-Gemma-2-27B (Table 2). Both are evaluated on the same open-prompt and human-instruction subsets; the result supports this data recipe on this benchmark, not a universal claim about Chinese preference alignment. Table 4 further shows the complete CheemsPreference recipe outperforms its human-only, GPT-only, length-debiased, and distant-supervision ablations.
在 CheemsBench 上，CheemsRM 的总体分数为0.657，高于所列最强判别式基线 Skywork-Reward-Gemma-2-27B 的0.535（表2）。二者在相同的开源提示和人工指令子集上评测；该结果支持此数据配方在该基准上的效果，不能外推为中文偏好对齐的普遍结论。表4还显示，完整 CheemsPreference 配方优于仅人工、仅 GPT、仅长度去偏和仅远程监督的消融。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Earlier RM benchmarks are largely English and typically reduce each item to pairwise labels. CHEEMS changes the Chinese evaluation object to five responses with human triple-wise comparisons and conflict-resolved partial rankings, while using a human-filtered GPT subset to scale training data. Its contribution is the coupled Chinese benchmark-and-data recipe, not the Bradley-Terry loss or use of GPT annotation itself.
既有奖励模型基准主要面向英语，且通常把每个项目化为成对标签。CHEEMS 将中文评测对象改为5个回答、人工三元比较和冲突消解后的部分排序，同时以人工过滤的 GPT 子集扩展训练数据。其新意是相互配套的中文基准与数据配方，而非 Bradley-Terry 损失或 GPT 标注本身。

title: Limitations
局限
html: The authors note that a Chinese focus may miss regional variation and introduce language or cultural bias. Human judgments and the particular annotator group can also encode biased preferences; released real instructions and responses can contain harmful content. Before reuse, inspect the annotator protocol, consent and filtering policy, data license, and performance on the target Chinese community rather than treating the labels as universal values.
作者指出，聚焦中文可能遗漏地区差异并引入语言或文化偏差；人工判断及特定标注群体也可能编码偏见，公开的真实指令和回答还可能含有有害内容。复用前应检查标注协议、同意与过滤政策、数据许可，以及在目标中文社群上的表现，不能把标签视作普遍价值。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: A Chinese RM builder can use CheemsBench to compare a candidate RM against partial human rankings, reporting accuracy and exact match separately on open and human prompts. Given Chinese prompts and candidate responses, the CheemsPreference construction pattern can produce filtered preference edges for RM training. Do not use it unchanged for another language, safety policy, or population without relabeling and downstream-correlation checks.
中文奖励模型开发者可用 CheemsBench 的部分人工排序比较候选模型，并在开源提示和人工提示上分别报告准确率与精确匹配。已有中文提示和候选回答时，可复用 CheemsPreference 的构造模式生成过滤后的偏好边以训练奖励模型。若语言、安全政策或目标人群不同，必须重新标注并检查下游相关性，不能原样使用。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
1. CHEEMS targets the Chinese RM reliability gap with a benchmark and training dataset, not only a new RM.
  2. CheemsBench uses five responses, triple-wise human comparisons, and partial rankings.
  3. CheemsPreference has 27,861 instructions and combines human labels with RM-filtered GPT-4o comparisons.
  4. CheemsRM scores 0.657 overall on CheemsBench; the listed strongest baseline scores 0.535.
  5. Reuse requires checking annotation population, license, harmful-content filtering, and target-language fit.

1. CHEEMS 以基准和训练数据处理中文奖励模型可靠性缺口，而不只是训练一个新模型。
  2. CheemsBench 使用5个回答、人工三元比较和部分排序。
  3. CheemsPreference 有27,861条指令，结合人工标签与奖励模型过滤的 GPT-4o 比较。
  4. CheemsRM 在 CheemsBench 总分为0.657，所列最强基线为0.535。
  5. 复用前须检查标注人群、许可、有害内容过滤和目标语言匹配度。
